key_insight: The paper reframes sparse regularized partial optimal transport as a penalty-based smooth optimization problem, enabling an accelerated first-order solver that preserves sparsity and improves efficiency.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical, scalable way to compute interpretable transport plans for applications like color transfer, domain adaptation, and point cloud registration.
method: Uses a penalty reformulation to handle partial OT with smooth, strongly convex sparsity-inducing regularizers.
Applies an accelerated first-order scheme with alternating smooth gradient updates and simple projection steps.
Supports a broad class of regularizers, including quadratic and elastic-net style penalties.
evidence_signal: Across benchmarks on color transfer, domain adaptation, and point cloud registration, the method reports lower transport cost, higher sparsity, and faster convergence than established baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on careful penalty and step-size tuning, and projection quality may affect stability and convergence in large-scale settings.
paper_title: Accelerated Algorithm for Sparse Regularized Partial Optimal Transport
